message: サバイバル×リサイクル

name: Sally
message: 「Kyuuu~ I looost~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is what true teamwork is」

name: Sally
message: 「Uuugh. That's just strength in numbers!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, as the spoils of war, I'll be taking this plushie-powered bicycle」

name: Sally
message: 「N-Not thaaat!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why are you so attached to this bicycle?」

name: Misa
message: 「You too, though」

name: Sally
message: 「Because with this... with this, I'm gonna eat beef bowls until I'm stuffed!」

name: Synn
message: 「Beef bowls... with a bicycle...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I get it! Self-generated electricity」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Sally
message: 「Wrong! Like I'd ever do anything that eco-friendly! I'm trading the bicycle for beef bowls!」

name: Synn
message: 「Trading...」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be that you mean bartering?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, yeah! It's common sense in the Demon World!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hoho~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Something this shady definitely came through Demon World Mail-Order. It's certainly got enough value to order an extra-large beef bowl」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's amazing!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If it were a normal bicycle, even a cheap one could get you more than ten refills, you know」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That kind of trade might be the norm in the Demon World. However, in this world, markets thrive using a currency called money!」
In one hand she clutched the remains of Tontoro and a 500-yen coin, and in the other, a guidebook.

name: Sally
message: 「Then hand that over!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「N-N-No way!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmph, stingy! Why can't you understand that I'm bartering like this because I don't have any money!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I totally get wanting to eat something delicious. Still, if it's not something we actually want, the deal's a no-go.」

name: Sally
message: 「Whatever! Someday I'll pay you back for today's grudge... uh, um, what's the word for times like this...?」

name: Ria
message: 「With interest?」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah, that's it! I'm gonna pay you back with tons of interest! Just you remember this, Crusaders!」
Sally scooped up the dizzy Mochimochi, Jangara, and Tinun and flew off.

name: Sally
message: 「Oops, forgot my bike, teehee」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. I feel for her, I really do, but this puts us in a tough spot.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Plushie-style bicycle...」

name: Ria
message: 「You were still hung up on that\s02」

name: Tame-san
message: 「You know that cute little girl?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, 'know' might not be quite right... how should I put it...」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Every now and then, that kid stares at the snack toys with these longing eyes. Felt bad for her so I threw one in on the house, and she goes and eats just the candy while leaving the toy behind.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's the opposite of normal.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「At my place it's pretty harmless, but apparently other shops have been getting a whole string of complaints about her.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「So hey. Think you could wrap things up nice and clean like you did just now?」

name: Synn
message: 「Right. Understood.」

name: Tame-san
message: 「In return--not that it's much--I'll give you my full support for the bazaar!」

name: Ria
message: 「Thank you very much for giving us so many unwanted goods.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tame-san, are you sure it's okay for us to take all this?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Don't sweat it, don't sweat it. When the poster girl of Yuugiri-an asks, I can't very well say no.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, saying stuff you don't even mean! You're making me blush!」

name: Misa
message: 「You're quite popular, aren't you, Nanaka-san...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka is the idol of the shopping district, after all」

name: Ria
message: 「Ooh~. Amazi~~ng」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so jealous~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, I'm nothing like that. If anyone's an idol, it suits Lolo-chan way better」

name: Misa
message: 「I'd say she's more of a mascot than an idol, wouldn't you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A mascot? What exactly does a mascot do?」

name: Ria
message: 「You put on a fluffy costume and go, 'Hello♪ I'm Ravi-chan from Bunny Land♪ Nice to meet you, everyone♪' and stuff like that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That sounds so fun~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much for everything」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yeah! I'll come check it out on the day of! Do your best out there, Student Council!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes!」
